budgets.tokenFallback: Elapsed time and tool-call ceiling; checkpoint before exhaustion.

consumedAtAuthoring.scope: Owner-adopted implementation starts with root canonical dispatch; preparation has not executed production or verification. Earlier planning remains separate.

budgets.accounting: Track actual elapsed dispatch time and tool calls honestly, including waits; automatic remote jobs are a separate post-local-BDD gate, not additional local unit commands or a silent budget reset. Preserve estimated versus measured telemetry.
budgets.exhaustion: Checkpoint and report BLOCKED/unmet; do not broaden scope, weaken checks or claim merge readiness.
